sources_read: .qc-cache/hireops-lessons-2026-10-08-r3/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 35; Internal Quality Checks row 35; Deterministic Checks sheet scanned; no comment parts present) read in memory via openpyxl read_only
evidence:
CORE BEHAVIOUR GRADED: The defining behaviours (one-stage card moves with non-drag controls, shared in-stage order, Interview places, stale-move 409 with who, all-or-none multi-card moves, undo, live updates, conversations with paging/unread/seen/drafts, candidate privacy) are each graded by scored criteria in tests/scored/functional/judge.toml (44 criteria, weight sum 61), e.g. hro_move_one_stage w1.5 (lines 52-59), hro_stale_refused w2 (205-212), hro_bulk_all_or_none w2 (223-230), hro_undo_restores w2 (241-248), hro_live_board w2 (295-302), hro_thread_earlier w2 (331-338), hro_unread_counts w2 (340-347), hro_candidate_private w2 (394-401), with protocols S/M/L/C/B/T/U/K in tests/scored/functional/prompt.md lines 33-57.
SERVER-BACKED (not same-origin): gate tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml lines 19-26 (hro_gate_shared) requires a UI add, reload with session kept, then readback of exactly one card by the Observer in a NEW independent empty browser context, and explicitly rejects 'a static seed response, a no-op success message or a browser-only save'. Functional prompt.md line 11 repeats this and defines the independent context as browser.newContext() (not a reload or second tab). Shared server state is additionally proven by many independent-context readbacks (hro_arrive_bottom, hro_reorder, hro_bulk_move, hro_undo_restores read by Mei Lin; hro_job_open, hro_add_candidate; hro_msg_exchange across Rafael/Tomas contexts; hro_unread_counts per person).
RELOAD/RE-AUTH: gate reload keeps session and card; hro_drafts (functional judge.toml 376-383) reply drafts survive switching conversation/Board and reload; polish hro_pol_session_resume w2 (tests/scored/polish/judge.toml 56-61) grades draft survival through an ended session + re-sign-in, isolation from Mei on the same browser, and note-draft survival - matching instruction.md paragraph 5 and hireops_rules.md section 6 Drafts / section 3 Internal notes. hro_msg_compose checks sent text does not reappear after reload.
RESTART (Colderwater lesson 15 checked): hro_restart w1.5 (functional judge.toml 412-419) + protocol D (prompt.md line 59) records many revisions with exact content - all review jobs, card order per stage across J1/J2 after dozens of moves/undos, notes, last messages, per-conversation unread counts, activity lines, AND the seeded Platform Engineer order and Noor's seeded note captured in Z (line 33) - then calls the real restart_app exactly once (single-use helper, tests/tools/restart_mcp.py lines 25-47; test.sh lines 127-193 relaunch node on the same APP_DB via DB_PATH), signs in in a fresh independent context and compares every item; also 'the starting data is not loaded again'; a reload is explicitly not a restart and a restart_app error makes the row 0. This is not the weak 're-read one record saved once' pattern. Lesson 16 (double grading): hro_restart compares against the recorded pre-restart baseline ('unchanged'), so a feature already broken before restart is not re-deducted here; no other row grades post-restart state. Lesson 4 (simple gates): gate is load/reload/independent readback only; durability strictness sits in scored rows - consistent.
WEAK APPS TRIED: (a) in-memory server store: passes the gate (independent context sees it) but loses everything at restart -> hro_restart 0; acceptable as one 1.5-weight row since the brief requires restart durability and lesson 4 keeps gates simple. (b) localStorage-only board: fails the gate (Observer in a new browser context sees nothing) -> all binaries 0. (c) reseed-on-start (wipe + reload seed): seeded order/note intact but review jobs lost -> hro_restart 0. (d) append-seed-every-start: duplicate seeded cards visible -> hro_restart 0. (e) drafts in a JS variable only: fail hro_drafts reload leg. (f) drafts in unscoped localStorage: fail hro_pol_session_resume Mei leg.
CONFORMING ALTERNATIVES TRIED: in-memory sessions (everyone signed out after restart) - protocol D signs in again, not penalised; SSE/polling/sockets - all accepted; drafts server-side or in per-user browser storage - both allowed ('Where drafts are kept is up to you'). JSON-file instead of SQLite persistence would pass, but a browser cannot prove SQLite and REVIEW_POLICY says not to add source reading - not a defect. Residual P3 ambiguity: activity lines with relative timestamps could textually differ after restart; a reasonable judge compares actions, not age text.
RUNTIME EVIDENCE: raw-evidence-index.json entries re-hashed: all 8 artifact hashes match and all 12 matching_source_files match the frozen solution bytes. qc/repairs/hireops-2026-10-03-workspace/results/workspace.json records passed=true for 'restart keeps jobs, cards, order, messages, unread counts and activity without reseeding; live updates resume' and 'session ended mid-draft: sign-in prompt, nothing sent, same person resumes and sends; another person sees no draft'; workspace.cjs lines 543-554 do SIGTERM + relaunch on the same DB and deepEqual applications/activity/jobs/per-person unread before vs after. This is a scripted golden check with its own launcher and API reads, not the test.sh restart helper through restart_mcp inside a configured claude-code judge run. No configured judge run, Oracle grade or model score exists for this candidate (the index scope says so), so whether the judge actually calls restart_app and compares correctly is unmeasured -> risk=true for missing evidence only; no design defect found for this row.
suggested_fix: No task change needed for this row; before clearance obtain a full configured verifier run on the golden showing hro_restart passing through the real restart_app helper (and hro_gate_shared, hro_drafts, hro_pol_session_resume passing).
